<WORKER-BRIEF>

- **Source:** This finding comes from an audit agent. It is not a GitHub review comment. The agent built a playground app against this PR in 28 configurations. The user (reidbaker) asked that the PR's worker act on the audit's findings. Other findings will reach you in separate briefs, so handle only 2A here.

  The report's method section, verbatim:

  > **Verification**: Every output APK in `build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/` and `build/app/outputs/apk/` was inspected with `aapt2 dump badging`.

  Section 2A, verbatim:

  > ### 2A. Following the error message's `-P force-version-code-ignoring-abi=true` suggestion when no `versionCode` exists builds **un-installable APKs (`versionCode=''`)**
  >
  > When neither `android {}` nor `src/main/AndroidManifest.xml` sets a `versionCode`:
  > - **Flutter 3.47**: Used `-1` (`variant.mergedFlavor.versionCode`) and silently built APKs with `versionCode='999'`, `'1999'`, `'3999'` (`1000 * abi + (-1)`).
  > - **PR #196561**: Fails cleanly (big improvement!), and prints:
  >   > `Set versionCode = flutter.versionCode in defaultConfig (or on each product flavor), or pass -P force-version-code-ignoring-abi=true to keep one versionCode.`
  >
  > **Escape-Hatch Trap**
  > If the developer follows the second suggestion on that exact project:
  > ```bash
  > flutter build apk --debug --split-per-abi -P force-version-code-ignoring-abi=true
  > ```
  > the build **exits `0`** and writes `app-armeabi-v7a-debug.apk`, `app-arm64-v8a-debug.apk`, and `app-x86_64-debug.apk` with **`versionCode=''` (empty / missing in the compiled binary `AndroidManifest.xml`)**. `adb install` rejects those APKs on Android devices. Saying *"to keep one versionCode"* when no `versionCode` exists anywhere misleads the user into producing broken APKs.

- **Claims and evidence:** I have not reproduced any of these. The report gives a general method but no command output for this case. Reproduce each claim before you act on it.
  1. On the PR head, with no `versionCode` in `android {}` or in the main `AndroidManifest.xml`, `flutter build apk --split-per-abi` fails and prints the message quoted above. **Not reproduced.**
  2. Adding `-P force-version-code-ignoring-abi=true` to that project makes the build exit `0` and write the three per-ABI debug APKs. **Not reproduced.**
  3. `aapt2 dump badging` shows `versionCode=''` for those APKs. The report says all APKs were checked with `aapt2 dump badging`, but it shows no output for this case. **Not reproduced.**
  4. `adb install` rejects those APKs. The report shows no `adb` command, output, device or API level. This may be an inference, not an observation. **Not reproduced.** Check it on a real device or emulator, and record the API level.
  5. Baseline: Flutter 3.47 without the flag built APKs with versionCode `999`, `1999` and `3999`. **Not reproduced.** Also check what 3.47 does *with* `-P force-version-code-ignoring-abi=true` on the same project. That tells us whether the empty versionCode is new in this PR or already in 3.47.

- **Task:** The reported problem: the PR's new error message points users to `-P force-version-code-ignoring-abi=true` "to keep one versionCode". When no versionCode exists anywhere, the report says that flag produces APKs with no versionCode that can't be installed, and the build still succeeds.

  First, reproduce claims 1–5 on head `7233196849d`. Record each command and its output: build exit code, `aapt2 dump badging <apk> | grep versionCode` for each APK, and the `adb install` result.

  If the problem reproduces, decide on the merits whether code, tests, or docs must change, then make those changes. Docs here includes the error message text. Code could mean how the escape hatch behaves when no versionCode exists. You might decide more than one area needs changes. Explain your choice. If it doesn't reproduce, or if it already happens in 3.47 with the flag and doesn't belong in this PR, say so and propose a follow-up or a decline.

  Report the finding as **changed**, **modified**, or **declined**, with the reproduction evidence. Any new test must fail on `7233196849d` and pass with your change. Show both runs.

  - Branch `vcfix-manifest-fallback`, starting from head `7233196849d`. Merge; don't rebase.
  - Scope is finding 2A only. Don't fold in other audit findings.
